model.name: Drawer non-sprint detail render (graph-independent /api/ior fetch-fallback)
model.description: The type-specific detail renderers (task/requirement/class/method/implementation/usecase/test/file/webitem) render CONTENT even when the drawer has no graph (scenario-view) or the unit is not in the graph (chain-only impl/test). BUG: they resolve via this.graph.get(uuid) -> 'not found' -> empty (~125 chars) when graph is null OR the unit is not in the graph; only renderSprintDetail + rb-detail-view fetch /api/ior. FIX: a graph-independent unit resolver (resolveDetailUnit) that uses this.graph.get(uuid) when present ELSE fetches /api/ior (mirroring renderSprintDetail), used by every type-specific render - so task/class/impl detail renders content in scenario-view AND trace-page AND for chain-only units. Sprint render unchanged. Client-facing -> version-bump.
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-15: selecting a task / class / impl in the drawer shows NO content (empty). (Sprint detail renders; the type-specific detail elements render empty when there is no graph.)

discoverySource.note: Split from R30.20 (PO-ruled: R30.20=closeOrReturn CLOSE, R30.21=non-sprint RENDER). CAUSE (expert): type-specific detail elements (rb-task/class/method/implementation/requirement/usecase/test/file/webitem-detail) use this.graph.get(uuid) -> empty when graph null (scenario-view) OR unit not-in-graph (chain-only). renderSprintDetail + rb-detail-view already /api/ior fetch; type-specific ones LACK it. FIX: shared /api/ior fetch-fallback. RbDetailDrawer d86af73d REUSE 38->39m. Sole-minter; requirements.md same-commit; version-bump (client-facing). Impl shared-vs-per-element = expert call.

model.crossRefNote: Mirrors R30.3 renderSprintDetail (6cd770df) which fetches /api/ior - extend the SAME fetch-fallback to the type-specific detail renders. Sibling of R30.20 (drawer closeOrReturn); the SPLIT (R30.20=close, R30.21=render). Class RbDetailDrawer REUSE d86af73d. NEW Method resolveDetailUnit = the graph-independent resolver (graph.get else /api/ior); each type-specific render routes through it. Expert resolves shared-helper vs per-element at build.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A graph-independent unit resolver (RbDetailDrawer.resolveDetailUnit) uses this.graph.get(uuid) when available ELSE fetches /api/ior (mirroring renderSprintDetail) - so a detail renders whether the graph is set (trace-page) or null (scenario-view).

ALL type-specific detail renders resolve through it: task / requirement / class / method / implementation / usecase / test / file / webitem - each renders CONTENT (not the ~125-char empty) in scenario-view AND trace-page.
Chain-only units NOT in the graph (e.g. impl 7f15c149, real task 5665a0dd) render via the /api/ior fetch - no longer empty.
renderSprintDetail (R30.3) still works unchanged; the sprint detail (~5135 chars) is not affected.
The R30.20-drawer case-5 (SELECT node -> content) flips GREEN: selecting a task/class/impl node in scenario-view renders its detail content (was the RED baseline).
Tron visual + DET-3x: select task/class/impl in scenario-view (no graph) -> content renders; trace-page still renders; sprint unchanged. Client-facing -> shipped WITH a version-bump.
